titles.title: A Da Capo for a Musical Genius
Da Capo for a Musical Genius

description:
The pianist who won the Van Cliburn Competition at the youngest age, 'Seon-yul'.

That night, while returning home after a successful concert, he lost his family and both hands in a traffic accident.

After spending over 10 years as a wreck, Seonyul wakes up in the body of a 17-year-old boy due to a certain incident.

The protagonist possessing the body of 'Jeong Seon-yul', a troublemaker looked at with contempt by everyone.

He continues his second musical life at his alma mater.
